lines: Ever wondered how you park a ship the size of three football fields?
This is Azipod Bridge. A free ship simulator that runs right in your browser.
Big cruise ships don't steer with a rudder. They steer with propellers that turn all the way around.
Point them where you want to go, add some power, and feel her slowly answer.
Sail into Miami on a real nautical chart, with real depths. Cut the corner, and you'll run aground.
Watch from the bridge, out on the wing, or from above. By day, at sunset, or at night.
Then comes the hard part. Bring her in, gently, alongside the pier.
Free on your phone, tablet, or computer. Think you can dock her?
